title: CAD manufacturing-intent check result (result.json of a bundle.checks bundle)
description: One producer's required-check packet for one version: the obligations it was asked to cover (manufacturing_intent.required_checks, enumerated before it ran), one outcome per obligation, its findings, the dependency fingerprints it read and whether it covered every expected obligation. A producer cannot shrink its scope by omission: an expected obligation without an outcome makes the packet incomplete, and unknown never counts as pass

producer.description: the writing tool and its version

dependencies.description: sha256 of each input the producer read, by name, such as the part record, material and capability profiles and the geometry

complete.description: true only when every expected obligation has an outcome

result.description: fail if any outcome fails, else unknown if any is unknown or the packet is incomplete, else pass (not_applicable outcomes aside)
